label: Formulated and championed the rational equality of the sexes in A Vindication of the Rights of Woman
description: Mary Wollstonecraft formulated and introduced the concept of "Rational Equality of the Sexes", which became a seminal contribution in political philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in political.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Enlightenment & Social Contract as part of Mary Wollstonecraft's canonical writings.

label: Pioneered philosophical feminist argumentation that directly informed Mill and Harriet Taylor Mill's utilitarian campaign for female emancipation
description: John Stuart Mill was fundamentally influenced by Mary Wollstonecraft's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Mary Wollstonecraft's perspective to John Stuart Mill's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Enlightenment & Social Contract across history into the 19th Century Divergences.
